findings.text: non-blocking: the inner flux() of _mutual_edge_evaluator re-implements the circular-filament flux the repository already owns at nova/biot/greens.py:405 traced_filament_greens (and greens.py:324 greens_psi): same span/gap/complement algebra, same MU0*sqrt(span)*value form. The fragment correctly refutes the plan's two named primitives (_traced_psi_gradient, _edge_flux), but traced_filament_greens is the direct owner and is never named; the graded quadrature and the r==0|sr==0 guard could have been added to that owner instead of to a second copy.

non-blocking: _average_external builds its own triangle fan and Gauss rule per polygon, duplicating the polygonal-section quadrature the repository owns at nova/biot/sectionaverage.py:185 section_nodes, which already accepts an (n,2) corner array at any order and returns positive weights summing to the material area; the axisymmetric weight this needs is that area weight times the sample radius. A second copy of an owned capability rather than an extension of it.

non-blocking: the weighted-reciprocity assertion cannot fail for the landed implementation. energy is formed as volume[:, None] * gram while gram is returned as the symmetrised energy divided by volume[:, None] in galerkin_cell_interaction, and tiledassembly.py:787-788 forces exact symmetry, so energy - energy.T is zero whatever the quadrature computes. The two sides are not independent: it does redden on the centroid mutant (a different formulation), but it does not guard a regression inside the Galerkin kernel.

non-blocking: the negative-control paragraph says 'Both reciprocal-energy test cases fail ... two failed test IDs', but the delivered pin-control/negative-control.log records three failing ids (regions 0, 1, 2) with weighted defects 0.0511401, 0.0002193 and 0.0910275, and the manifest records '3 failed'. The fragment understates the control it reports.

non-blocking: the external-field error message still says '(cells, 2)' while the callback now receives volume-quadrature points (docstring line 367, _average_external line 134). The message names a shape the callback no longer receives and misdirects a caller debugging it.

non-blocking: points is an implicit None sentinel that switches cell_interaction from point collocation to the Galerkin operator behind one signature. scripts/magnetisation_high_permeability/measure.py:178 wraps that callable and keys a cache on points, so the new runtime path cell_interaction(cells, None, plan) reaches points.tobytes() with None; a separately named function would have left the point route's contract intact.
